# Nitevault

> Nitevault manufactures anti-tampering, hands-free wearable drink holsters and hermetically sealed bio-film pouches designed for music festivals, nightclubs, and open-air live events.

## Core Products & Direct-to-Consumer (B2C)
- **Pouch 5-Pack (€19.99):** 5x compost-ready bio-film pouches, 500ml (17oz) capacity each, 50mm rapid pour aperture (fits draft taps, cocktail pours, and standard festival ice cubes), hermetic twist-lock bite valve, micro CO2 pressure release vent. Bring-your-own-bag tier, folds flat for carrying.
- **Complete Holster Kit (€99.99):** 1x chest-worn festival sling holster with inward-facing anti-theft phone armor, plus 5x compost-ready bio-film refill pouches. Available in Barcelona (Tan Suede), Berlin (Matte Black), and Ibiza (Sand Beige) editions. Wearable as a crossbody chest sling or unhooked and stowed in a bag.
- **Founding Patron Trilogy (€499.00):** Limited to 25 serialized units worldwide. Includes all 3 city editions, custom serialized laser-engraved hardware, 3 years of pouch supply (20 free refills per season), and a private founder advisory channel with VIP event access.

## B2B Festival & Venue Integrations
- **URL:** https://nitevault.com/partnerships.html
- **Target Audience:** Music festival promoters, night/beach club operators, and alcohol beverage brand sponsors.
- **Operational Benefits:** 5-second rapid bar pour time, zero single-use plastic cups, zero broken cup dancefloor debris, elimination of open-cup drink-spiking liability and its reputational/legal fallout for organizers and sponsors.
- **Customization Options:** Custom PMS hardware colors, branded screen printing, custom fill volume lines for brand sponsor activations (e.g., rum, gin, ready-to-drink cocktails).
- **Scale Tiers:** 100-250 units, 250-500 units, 500-1,000 units, 1,000-2,500 units, 2,500-5,000 units, 5,000+ units (major activation).

## Materials & Compliance
- Bio-polymer pouch material is FDA 21 CFR and LFGB certified for food contact.
- 100% BPA, BPS, and phthalate-free.
- Alcohol-resistant up to 40% ABV, stable with acidic mixers, zero odor retention, reusable across multiple festival cycles.
